Anna is interested in swimming. There are always many people at the story-writing desk. Both of them like chicken and juice. The singer has a beautiful voice.
They took many photos at the story-writing desk. Eva thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Eva wrote about the day in the diary. They dance at the party.
The weather was sunny that day. Life is full of small surprises. Eva usually has chicken for breakfast. The violin is a difficult instrument.
Eva wants to be a driver in the future. Last Thursday, Eva and Anna went to the photo club. Anna's birthday is in September.
